=== DIFF: package.json ===
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
     "dev": "astro dev",
     "build": "astro build",
     "preview": "astro preview",
-    "lint": "eslint . && prettier --check . && bun scripts/check-tokens.ts",
+    "lint": "eslint . && prettier --check . && tsc --noEmit && bun scripts/check-tokens.ts",
     "format": "prettier --write .",
     "test": "bun test"
   },


=== DIFF: tsconfig.json ===

   "include": [".astro/types.d.ts", "**/*"],
   "exclude": ["dist"],
   "compilerOptions": {
-    "baseUrl": ".",
     "paths": {
-      "@/*": ["src/*"]
+      "@/*": ["./src/*"]
     }
   }
 }


Investigate per the method in your instructions, then return the findings list.
